# Vendor: slop-deps

These files are auto-synchronized copies of the CLI core modules from `src/` to support in-browser dependency scanning without Node runtime dependencies.

- `corpus.generated.js` is generated by `scripts/sync-vendor.mjs` (run automatically during `npm run prebuild`).
- Do not edit `corpus.generated.js` by hand. To refresh the corpus, run `npm run prebuild` or `node scripts/sync-vendor.mjs`.
